basic_info.description: We've got an exciting new price! This beautiful, fully-detached, 1,179 sq ft single-family home, built around 1890, offers a wonderful blend of comfort, style, and convenience. This turn-key 2 bed, 2 bath residence is a must-see. The main level boasts a spacious family room, an updated full bath, and high ceilings. The updated kitchen features ample cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and an eat-in dining area. Large windows flood every room with bright natural light, there are gleaming hardwood floors and a walk-out deck that is perfect for al fresco dining (and includes a side yard garden). The lower level offers a large family room with built-in bookshelves, beautiful tile floors, the second updated full bath, and the spacious primary bedroom, complete with a large closet. The finished laundry room includes a newer washer and gas dryer. Recent updates include new carpeting, a new roof in 2018, and new drainage in 2024. Entirely fenced-in yard, additional storage in the attic, under the front stairs and under the deck. Don't miss this opportunity for your very own home.
